items.title: 12.2.9 If theta is measured in radian, then Lim_{theta->0} sin(theta)/theta = 1. (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Yeh trigonometry ki sab se ahem limit hai, aur aage derivative of \(\sin x\) (Unit 13) isi par khara hai. Is sabaq mein hum ise ek circle ki figure aur pichle sabaq ke Sandwich Theorem se saabit karenge, phir kitab ki do misaalein hal karenge.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Pehle masla dekhiye: \(\theta = 0\) rakhein to \(\frac{\sin 0}{0} = \frac{0}{0}\). Aur \(\sin\theta\) mein se \(\theta\) ko cancel bhi nahin kar sakte, kyun ke "sin" koi number nahin jo \(\theta\) se zarb ho raha ho; yeh ek function ka naam hai. Is liye algebra yahan haar jata hai aur geometry (shakal) madad karti hai.
"Measured in radian" kyun zaroori hai? Radian mein unit circle par arc ki lambai bilkul angle ke barabar hoti hai. Chhote angle par arc aur us ke neeche wali seedhi line (\(\sin\theta\)) taqreeban barabar hote hain, isi liye ratio 1 ke qareeb aata hai. Degree mein yeh limit \(\frac{\pi}{180}\) aati, 1 nahin.
Khud sochiye: neeche table dekhiye; angle jitna chhota, ratio utna 1 ke qareeb.

blocks.caption: Our table (not in the book): the ratio approaches 1 as the angle shrinks

blocks.text: Proof: Is limit ko nikaalne ke liye hum ek naya tareeqa istemal karte hain. \(\theta\) ko ek circle ka positive acute central angle (markazi tez zaviya) lein jis ka radius \(r = 1\) hai. Figure mein \(OAB\) circle ka ek sector (qaash, pizza ke tukre jaisa hissa) hai. \(A\) aur \(B\) ko milaayein, aur \(OB\) ko aage \(D\) tak barhaayein is tarah ke \(OA \perp AD\). Phir \(B\) se \(OA\) par perpendicular \(BC\) kheenchein.

blocks.alt: Sector OAB of a circle with centre O and radius 1 (r = 1 marked on OB and on OA), angle theta at O. OB is extended to D with AD perpendicular to OA, so triangle OAD is right-angled at A. BC is perpendicular to OA with a right-angle mark at C, and the chord BA is drawn.
blocks.caption: Figure: sector OAB of the unit circle with triangles OAB and OAD (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text:
Diya hai \(|OA| = |OB| = 1\) (unit circle ke radii).
Right triangle \(OCB\) mein,
\[\sin\theta = \dfrac{|BC|}{|OB|} = |BC|\]
Right triangle \(OAD\) mein,
\[\tan\theta = \dfrac{|AD|}{|OA|} = |AD|\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kyun yeh do lambaaiyan? Sine = saamne wali side / hypotenuse, aur tan = saamne wali side / saath wali side. Unit circle mein \(OB = 1\) aur \(OA = 1\) hain, to neeche 1 aa jata hai aur \(\sin\theta\) bilkul \(BC\) ki lambai, aur \(\tan\theta\) bilkul \(AD\) ki lambai ban jate hain. Yahi is figure ka kamaal hai: teen numbers \(\sin\theta\), \(\theta\), \(\tan\theta\) ab teen areas ban jayenge.

Ab teen areas nikaalte hain:
(i) Area of \(\Delta OAB\)
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}|OA||BC| = \dfrac{1}{2}(1)(\sin\theta)\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\sin\theta\]
(ii) Area of sector \(OAB\)
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}r^{2}\theta = \dfrac{1}{2}(1)(\theta) = \dfrac{1}{2}\theta\]
and
(iii) Area of \(\Delta OAD\)
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}|OA||AD| = \dfrac{1}{2}(1)(\tan\theta)\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\tan\theta\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Area (ii) mein sector ka formula \(\frac{1}{2}r^{2}\theta\) laga hai, jo sirf radian mein sahi hai; yahi wajah hai ke theorem mein "radian" ki shart hai. Triangle \(OAB\) ka base \(OA = 1\) aur height \(BC = \sin\theta\) hai; triangle \(OAD\) ka base \(OA = 1\) aur height \(AD = \tan\theta\). Triangle ka area = \(\frac{1}{2}\) base \(\times\) height.

From the figure we see that
Area of \(\Delta OAB\) < Area of sector \(OAB\) < Area of \(\Delta OAD\)
\[\Rightarrow \dfrac{1}{2}\sin\theta < \dfrac{\theta}{2} < \dfrac{1}{2}\tan\theta\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Yeh tarteeb kyun? Figure dekhiye: triangle \(OAB\) sector ke andar hai (seedhi chord \(AB\) gol arc ke andar ki taraf hai), aur poora sector bare triangle \(OAD\) ke andar hai. Jo hissa doosre ke andar ho, us ka area chhota hota hai. Yani chhota triangle < sector < bara triangle.

\(\sin\theta\) positive hai, is liye har hisse ko \(\frac{1}{2}\sin\theta\) se divide karne par:
\[1 < \dfrac{\theta}{\sin\theta} < \dfrac{1}{\cos\theta} \quad \left(0 < \theta < \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right)\]

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text:
Kitab mein \(\theta\) ki range \(0 < \theta < \frac{n}{2}\) chhapi hai. Sahi range yeh hai (kyun ke \(\theta\) positive acute angle hai):
\[0 < \theta < \dfrac{\pi}{2}\]

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh qadam dhyan se dekhiye. Positive number se divide karne par \(<\) ke nishaan nahin badalte. Teesra hissa:
\[\dfrac{\frac{1}{2}\tan\theta}{\frac{1}{2}\sin\theta} = \dfrac{\sin\theta/\cos\theta}{\sin\theta} = \dfrac{1}{\cos\theta}\]
Phir agle qadam mein teeno ka ulta (reciprocal) liya gaya hai. Positive numbers ka ulta lene se nishaan palat jate hain: \(2 < 3\) magar \(\frac{1}{2} > \frac{1}{3}\). Isi liye \(<\) ban jata hai \(>\).

\[\text{i.e., } 1 > \dfrac{\sin\theta}{\theta} > \cos\theta\]
\[\text{or } \cos\theta < \dfrac{\sin\theta}{\theta} < 1\]
Jab \(\theta \to 0\) to \(\cos\theta \to 1\).

Ab Sandwich Theorem lagta hai: \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\theta}\) neeche se \(\cos\theta\) aur oopar se 1 ke beech phansa hua hai. Neeche wali roti \(\cos\theta \to 1\), aur oopar wali roti to hai hi 1. Dono 1 ki taraf, to beech wala bhi 1 ki taraf:
\[\lim_{\theta \to 0}\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\theta} = 1\]

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Kitab ka side box: yahi nateeja \(-\frac{\pi}{2} < \theta < 0\) ke liye bhi sahi hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Kyun? \(\frac{\sin(-\theta)}{-\theta} = \frac{-\sin\theta}{-\theta} = \frac{\sin\theta}{\theta}\); dono minus cancel ho jate hain. Yani negative angle par bhi ratio ki wahi value hai. Is liye baayen aur daayen dono taraf se limit 1 hai, aur poori limit 1.

blocks.title: Proof ka khulasa
blocks.text:
Poore proof ko chaar qadmon mein yaad kar lijiye, imtihan mein yahi tarteeb likhni hai:
1. Unit circle, angle \(\theta\), sector \(OAB\); \(BC \perp OA\) aur \(AD \perp OA\). Is se \(|BC| = \sin\theta\) aur \(|AD| = \tan\theta\).
2. Teen areas: \(\frac{1}{2}\sin\theta\), \(\frac{1}{2}\theta\), \(\frac{1}{2}\tan\theta\), aur figure se un ki tarteeb chhota < darmiyana < bara.
3. \(\frac{1}{2}\sin\theta\) se divide, phir reciprocal: \(\cos\theta < \frac{\sin\theta}{\theta} < 1\).
4. \(\cos\theta \to 1\), is liye Sandwich Theorem se limit 1.
Figure zaroor banaiye aur us par \(O, A, B, C, D\) aur \(\theta\) saaf likhiye; examiner sab se pehle figure hi dekhta hai.

Ab is nateeje ko kitab ki do misaalon mein istemal karte hain. Dono mein asal kaam ek hi hai: expression ko itna badlo ke us mein bilkul \(\frac{\sin(\text{cheez})}{\text{wahi cheez}}\) nazar aa jaye.

blocks.title: Example 8
steps:
Given: \(\frac{\sin 7\theta}{\theta}\), jab \(\theta \to 0\).
To find: is ki limit.
Method: sab se pehle seedha \(\theta = 0\) rakh kar dekhte hain: \(\frac{\sin 0}{0} = \frac{0}{0}\). Matlab tarkeeb chahiye. Yeh \(\frac{\sin x}{x}\) jaisa lagta hai, lekin sine ke andar angle \(7\theta\) hai aur neeche sirf \(\theta\). Standard nateeja tabhi lagta hai jab sine ke andar aur neeche bilkul ek hi cheez ho. Is liye variable badal kar dono ko barabar karenge.

Step 1: Variable badlein
\[\text{Let } x = 7\theta, \text{ so that } \theta = \dfrac{x}{7}\]
Jab \(\theta \to 0\) to \(x \to 0\).
Kyun: angle ko ek naya naam \(x\) de diya. Kyun ke \(x = 7\theta\), jab \(\theta\) zero ki taraf jaye to \(x\) bhi zero ki taraf jayega (7 guna zero bhi zero hai). Is liye nayi limit bhi \(x \to 0\) wali hai.

Step 2: Limit ko naye variable mein likhein
\[\lim_{\theta \to 0}\dfrac{\sin 7\theta}{\theta} = \lim_{x \to 0}\dfrac{\sin x}{\frac{x}{7}}\]
\[= 7\lim_{x \to 0}\dfrac{\sin x}{x}\]
Kyun: \(\frac{x}{7}\) se divide karna \(\frac{7}{x}\) se zarb dene ke barabar hai. Constant 7 ko limit ke bahar nikaal sakte hain (limits ka theorem: constant guna function ki limit = constant guna limit).

Step 3: Standard limit lagayein
\[= (7)(1) = 7\]
Kyun: 12.2.9 ke mutabiq \(\lim_{x \to 0}\frac{\sin x}{x} = 1\).

Tasdeeq:
Calculator ko radian mode mein rakh kar \(\theta = 0.01\) lein: \(\frac{\sin 0.07}{0.01} = \frac{0.069943}{0.01} \approx 6.994\). Yeh 7 ke bohat qareeb hai. Jawab sahi hai.

blocks.title: Example 9
steps:
Given: \(\frac{1-\cos\theta}{\theta}\), jab \(\theta \to 0\).
To find: is ki limit.
Method: \(\theta = 0\) rakhein to \(\frac{1-1}{0} = \frac{0}{0}\). Yahan seedha \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\theta}\) nazar nahin aata, kyun ke upar \(\cos\theta\) hai. Tarkeeb: upar neeche \(1 + \cos\theta\) (yani conjugate, jora jis mein sirf beech ka nishaan ulta hai) se zarb dein. Is se \(1 - \cos\theta\) badal kar \(\sin^{2}\theta\) ban jayega, aur sine aa gaya to \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\theta}\) bana sakenge.

Step 1: Conjugate se zarb dein
\[\dfrac{1-\cos\theta}{\theta} = \dfrac{1-\cos\theta}{\theta}\cdot\dfrac{1+\cos\theta}{1+\cos\theta}\]
\[= \dfrac{1-\cos^{2}\theta}{\theta(1+\cos\theta)}\]
Kyun: \((1-\cos\theta)(1+\cos\theta) = 1 - \cos^{2}\theta\), yeh \((a-b)(a+b) = a^{2} - b^{2}\) wala formula hai. Aur \(\frac{1+\cos\theta}{1+\cos\theta} = 1\), to value nahin badli.

Step 2: \(\sin^{2}\theta + \cos^{2}\theta = 1\) istemal karein
\[= \dfrac{\sin^{2}\theta}{\theta(1+\cos\theta)}\]
\[= \sin\theta\left(\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\theta}\right)\left(\dfrac{1}{1+\cos\theta}\right)\]
Kyun: \(1 - \cos^{2}\theta = \sin^{2}\theta\). Phir \(\sin^{2}\theta\) ko \(\sin\theta \cdot \sin\theta\) likha, taa ke ek \(\sin\theta\) neeche wale \(\theta\) ke saath jori bana kar standard ratio \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\theta}\) bana de, aur baqi do factors aasan rahein.

Step 3: Har factor ki limit lein
\[\lim_{\theta \to 0}\left(\dfrac{1-\cos\theta}{\theta}\right)\]
\[= \lim_{\theta \to 0}\sin\theta\cdot\lim_{\theta \to 0}\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\theta}\cdot\lim_{\theta \to 0}\dfrac{1}{1+\cos\theta}\]
\[= (0)(1)\left(\dfrac{1}{1+1}\right) = 0\]
Kyun: product ki limit = limits ka product (teeno limits maujood hain, is liye yeh theorem lag sakta hai). \(\sin 0 = 0\), \(\frac{\sin\theta}{\theta} \to 1\), aur \(\cos 0 = 1\) is liye aakhri factor \(\frac{1}{2}\). Zero se zarb ho kar jawab 0.

Tasdeeq:
\(\theta = 0.01\) radian lein: \(1 - \cos 0.01 \approx 0.0000500\), aur \(\frac{0.0000500}{0.01} = 0.005\). Yeh zero ke qareeb hai, aur \(\theta\) aur chhota karein to aur chhota hota jata hai. Jawab sahi hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Yeh hamari practice hai, kitab ki nahin.
(a) \(\lim_{\theta \to 0}\frac{\tan\theta}{\theta}\): \(\frac{\tan\theta}{\theta} = \frac{\sin\theta}{\theta}\cdot\frac{1}{\cos\theta} \to (1)(1) = 1\).
(b) \(\lim_{\theta \to 0}\frac{\sin 5\theta}{3\theta}\): \(\frac{5}{3}\cdot\frac{\sin 5\theta}{5\theta} \to \frac{5}{3}(1) = \frac{5}{3}\). Neeche \(5\theta\) banane ke liye upar neeche 5 se zarb kiya.
Khud sochiye: \(\lim_{\theta \to 0}\frac{\sin 2\theta}{\theta}\) kya hoga? (Jawab: 2.)

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. \(\lim_{\theta \to 0}\frac{\sin\theta}{\theta} = 1\), sirf radian mein.
2. Proof: chhota triangle < sector < bara triangle, yani \(\sin\theta < \theta < \tan\theta\), phir Sandwich Theorem.
3. \(\lim_{\theta \to 0}\frac{\sin k\theta}{\theta} = k\): neeche wahi cheez banao jo sine ke andar hai.
4. \(1 - \cos\theta\) dekho to \(1 + \cos\theta\) se zarb do; \(\sin^{2}\theta\) ban jayega.
5. \(\lim_{\theta \to 0}\frac{1-\cos\theta}{\theta} = 0\).

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\frac{\sin 7\theta}{\theta} = \sin 7\) likh dena, yani \(\theta\) cancel kar dena. "sin" zarb nahin, function hai; cancel nahin hota.
2. \(\lim\frac{\sin 7\theta}{\theta} = 1\) likh dena. Jab tak sine ke andar aur neeche ek hi cheez na ho, jawab 1 nahin.
3. Calculator degree mode mein rakh kar check karna. Yeh nateeja sirf radian ka hai; check karte waqt calculator radian (RAD) mode mein rakhein.
4. Reciprocal lete waqt inequality ke nishaan na palatna.
